curl.description: curl HTTP client. Tools return the raw response body; combine with the web-fetch skill for usage guidance.

tools.name: http_get
tools.description: Send an HTTP GET request and return the response body. Follows redirects, fails on HTTP errors (curl -fsSL). Best for fetching pages, JSON APIs and health checks.

params.name: url
params.description: Absolute http:// or https:// URL to request.

params.name: timeout_seconds
params.description: Seconds to wait for the request. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: http_post_json
tools.description: Send an HTTP POST request with a JSON body and return the response body (curl -fsSL -X POST -H Content-Type:application/json -d body). Requires user approval.

params.name: url
params.description: Absolute http:// or https:// URL to request.

params.name: body
params.description: Request payload as a JSON string.

params.name: timeout_seconds
params.description: Seconds to wait for the request. Defaults to 30.
